segments.text: We've gone over a number of laboratory techniques in this series, but now it's time to do something
segments.zh: 在本系列中，我们已经讲过许多实验技术，但现在该做点

segments.text: different.
segments.zh: 不一样的了。

segments.text: We are going to do an actual organic synthesis.
segments.zh: 我们要做一次真正的有机合成。

segments.text: We are going to build an organic molecule.
segments.zh: 我们要构建一个有机分子。

segments.text: As we have discussed in the lecture series, a big part of organic chemistry involves pathways
segments.zh: 正如我们在讲授系列中讨论过的，有机化学的很大一部分涉及

segments.text: that scientists have used over the years to synthesize specific organic molecules.
segments.zh: 科学家多年来用来合成特定有机分子的路线。

segments.text: These are used to synthesize everything from biomolecules to industrial materials to drugs.
segments.zh: 这些路线被用来合成各种东西，从生物分子到工业材料再到药物。

segments.text: Today we will synthesize aspirin.
segments.zh: 今天我们要合成阿司匹林。

segments.text: Aspirin is a drug used to reduce pain and inflammation, which we covered in detail over
segments.zh: 阿司匹林是一种用于减轻疼痛和炎症的药物，我们在药理学系列中

segments.text: in the pharmacology series.
segments.zh: 详细讲过它。

segments.text: Aspirin's chemical name is acetylsalicylic acid, and it is synthesized quite easily
segments.zh: 阿司匹林的化学名称是乙酰水杨酸，它可以很容易地

segments.text: in one step from salicylic acid.
segments.zh: 由水杨酸一步合成。

segments.text: As you can see in this scheme, we can convert salicylic acid to acetylsalicylic acid by
segments.zh: 如你在这个反应式中所见，我们可以让水杨酸与乙酸酐反应，

segments.text: reacting with acetic anhydride to introduce the acetyl group.
segments.zh: 引入乙酰基，把它转化为乙酰水杨酸。

segments.text: The hydroxyl group on salicylic acid attacks protonated acetic anhydride to pick up the
segments.zh: 水杨酸上的羟基进攻质子化的乙酸酐，从而接上

segments.text: acetyl group.
segments.zh: 乙酰基。

segments.text: This is what we're doing in the lab.
segments.zh: 这就是我们在实验室里要做的。

segments.text: We'll add the anhydride to salicylic acid, use a strong acid as a catalyst, and heat
segments.zh: 我们把乙酸酐加到水杨酸中，用一种强酸作催化剂，并加热

segments.text: the reaction to completion.
segments.zh: 使反应完全。

segments.text: We'll then perform crystallization steps to isolate and purify our aspirin.
segments.zh: 然后我们进行结晶步骤，分离和纯化阿司匹林。

segments.text: To finish, we'll use a simple qualitative test to see whether or not we have made
segments.zh: 最后，我们用一个简单的定性检验，看看我们是否制得

segments.text: and purified aspirin.
segments.zh: 并纯化了阿司匹林。

segments.text: The agents will include ethyl acetate, an irritant, and sulfuric acid, an extremely strong
segments.zh: 所用的试剂包括有刺激性的乙酸乙酯，以及硫酸这种极强的

segments.text: acid, so make sure you are using all the appropriate safety gear and precautions.
segments.zh: 酸，所以一定要使用所有合适的安全装备并采取相应的防护措施。

segments.text: To start, let's set up a hot water bath.
segments.zh: 首先，我们来准备一个热水浴。

segments.text: We'll put water in a 500 milliliter beaker and start heating it on a hot plate.
segments.zh: 我们在一个 500 毫升的烧杯中加水，放在加热板上开始加热。

segments.text: While that heats, let's prepare our reaction.
segments.zh: 加热的同时，我们来准备反应。

segments.text: We'll put about 2 grams of salicylic acid in a 125 milliliter Erlenmeyer flask, making
segments.zh: 我们把大约 2 克水杨酸放进一个 125 毫升的锥形瓶中，一定要

segments.text: sure to record the precise mass on our datasheet.
segments.zh: 在数据表上记录准确的质量。

segments.text: Let's add 5 milliliters of acetic anhydride to the powder.
segments.zh: 往粉末中加入 5 毫升乙酸酐。

segments.text: Let's also add 5 drops of concentrated sulfuric acid.
segments.zh: 再加入 5 滴浓硫酸。

segments.text: Swirl the mixture to make sure that everything is well mixed.
segments.zh: 摇动混合物，确保所有物质充分混合。

segments.text: We're now ready to heat our reaction vessel.
segments.zh: 现在我们可以加热反应容器了。

segments.text: To get even heating, we'll dip our flask in the hot water beaker instead of putting
segments.zh: 为了受热均匀，我们把锥形瓶浸在热水烧杯中，而不是把它

segments.text: it directly on a hot plate.
segments.zh: 直接放在加热板上。

segments.text: To do this, let's use a ring stand and a clamp to secure our flask.
segments.zh: 为此，我们用铁架台和夹子固定锥形瓶。

segments.text: Heat the water until it reaches around 80 or 90 degrees Celsius, and then leave the
segments.zh: 把水加热到大约 80 或 90 摄氏度，然后让

segments.text: reaction flask partially submerged in the hot water for about 10 minutes.
segments.zh: 反应瓶部分浸没在热水中大约 10 分钟。

segments.text: With our reaction complete, let's take it out of the hot water.
segments.zh: 反应完成后，我们把它从热水中取出来。

segments.text: We'll then let our solution cool down to room temperature.
segments.zh: 然后让溶液冷却到室温。

segments.text: Aspirin crystals should start to form as the solution cools down.
segments.zh: 随着溶液冷却，阿司匹林晶体应该会开始形成。

segments.text: As we covered in the recrystallization tutorial, you can use a glass rod to scratch the sides
segments.zh: 正如我们在重结晶教程中讲过的，必要时你可以用玻璃棒刮擦

segments.text: of the beaker to initiate crystallization if necessary.
segments.zh: 烧杯内壁来引发结晶。

segments.text: The glass particles scratched off will provide a surface for crystals to start forming.
segments.zh: 刮下来的玻璃颗粒会为晶体提供开始形成的表面。

segments.text: If you still do not see crystals, add about 10 milliliters of cold water to the reaction
segments.zh: 如果你还是看不到晶体，就往反应

segments.text: mixture.
segments.zh: 混合物中加入大约 10 毫升冷水。

segments.text: This will halt the reaction.
segments.zh: 这会终止反应。

segments.text: To make sure all the crystals have formed, let's dip our beaker in an ice water bath.
segments.zh: 为了确保所有晶体都已形成，我们把烧杯浸入冰水浴中。

segments.text: Leave it there for 10 minutes.
segments.zh: 在里面放 10 分钟。

segments.text: That should be enough for all the crystals to form.
segments.zh: 这应该足以让所有晶体形成。

segments.text: After we've formed aspirin crystals, let's collect them by vacuum filtration.
segments.zh: 形成阿司匹林晶体后，我们用减压抽滤把它们收集起来。

segments.text: Place some filter paper in the Buchner funnel and then add the solution.
segments.zh: 在布氏漏斗中放一些滤纸，然后加入溶液。

segments.text: Be sure to rinse the flask with cold water to get all of the product out, and also to
segments.zh: 一定要用冷水冲洗锥形瓶，把所有产物都转移出来，同时也

segments.text: wash with water to remove impurities.
segments.zh: 用水洗涤以除去杂质。

segments.text: Let's run the vacuum for a few minutes to make sure that everything is dry.
segments.zh: 让真空抽几分钟，确保所有东西都干了。

segments.text: Let's then collect our product in another vessel.
segments.zh: 然后我们把产物收集到另一个容器中。

segments.text: We'll make sure to save all our product by rinsing the filter paper with ethanol
segments.zh: 我们要用乙醇把滤纸上的产物冲洗到烧杯里，

segments.text: into our beaker.
segments.zh: 确保保留下所有产物。

segments.text: Even though we've collected our product, it is not totally pure.
segments.zh: 虽然我们已经收集到了产物，但它并不完全纯净。

segments.text: This is because it still has trace amounts of the starting materials.
segments.zh: 这是因为它仍然含有微量的起始原料。

segments.text: We'll have to perform recrystallization to purify our product.
segments.zh: 我们必须进行重结晶来纯化产物。

segments.text: Let's start by dissolving the impure aspirin in 5 milliliters of ethanol.
segments.zh: 首先，我们把不纯的阿司匹林溶解在 5 毫升乙醇中。

segments.text: While we do that, let's heat up some water on our hotplate.
segments.zh: 在溶解的同时，我们在加热板上加热一些水。

segments.text: We'll then add 50 milliliters of hot water to the crude sample.
segments.zh: 然后我们往粗品中加入 50 毫升热水。

segments.text: This will start to dissolve.
segments.zh: 它会开始溶解。

segments.text: Let's then add the vessel to the hotplate and start adding more solvent.
segments.zh: 然后我们把容器放到加热板上，并开始补加溶剂。

segments.text: After everything has dissolved, it is time to recrystallize.
segments.zh: 全部溶解后，就该重结晶了。

segments.text: Let's take our vessel off of the hotplate and place it at room temperature.
segments.zh: 我们把容器从加热板上拿下来，放在室温下。

segments.text: Over time we'll start to see crystals of aspirin form.
segments.zh: 过一段时间，我们会开始看到阿司匹林晶体形成。

segments.text: Give it time for all the crystals to form, and we can also scratch the sides to initiate
segments.zh: 给它足够的时间让所有晶体形成，我们也可以刮擦内壁来引发

segments.text: crystallization.
segments.zh: 结晶。

segments.text: Finally, put the vessel in an ice bath as before to make sure we've crystallized all
segments.zh: 最后，像之前一样把容器放进冰浴中，确保我们所有的产物

segments.text: of our product.
segments.zh: 都结晶出来了。

segments.text: Let's bring in the vacuum system again to dry our product one last time.
segments.zh: 我们再次用上真空系统，最后一次干燥产物。

segments.text: Before we do that, we'll weigh our filter paper and watch glass, as this will be used
segments.zh: 在此之前，我们要称量滤纸和表面皿，因为这会用于

segments.text: to measure the mass of our product.
segments.zh: 计算产物的质量。

segments.text: Now let's add the same filter paper to the vacuum system and start filtering.
segments.zh: 现在我们把同一张滤纸放到真空系统上，开始过滤。

segments.text: Let this go for a few minutes to make sure it's dry.
segments.zh: 让它抽几分钟，确保产物干燥。

segments.text: We can then put our filter paper with our product on the watch glass and leave it at
segments.zh: 然后我们可以把带有产物的滤纸放在表面皿上，放在

segments.text: room temperature to air dry, or use the oven at 65 degrees Celsius for 20 minutes.
segments.zh: 室温下自然晾干，或者用 65 摄氏度的烘箱烘 20 分钟。

segments.text: After you get a dry product, let's place it on a scale to weigh it.
segments.zh: 得到干燥的产物后，我们把它放到天平上称重。

segments.text: The mass of your purified sample is calculated by taking this number and subtracting the
segments.zh: 纯化后样品的质量，就是用这个数减去

segments.text: mass of the watch glass plus the filter paper that you measured earlier.
segments.zh: 你之前称得的表面皿加滤纸的质量。

segments.text: Once you're done with the synthesis, you have to make sure that the product you've
segments.zh: 完成合成后，你必须确认你所制得的产物

segments.text: made is the correct product.
segments.zh: 是正确的产物。

segments.text: In a typical chemistry lab we use melting point analysis, IR, NMR, TLC, and more, but
segments.zh: 在一般的化学实验室里，我们会用熔点分析、IR、NMR、TLC 等方法，但

segments.text: today we'll use a simple qualitative assay to confirm the presence and purity of our
segments.zh: 今天我们会用一个简单的定性检测来确认产物的存在和

segments.text: product.
segments.zh: 纯度。

segments.text: To do that, we'll use iron 3 chloride.
segments.zh: 为此，我们要用三氯化铁。

segments.text: This compound changes color from brownish red to purple in the presence of a phenol
segments.zh: 这种化合物遇到酚

segments.text: ring.
segments.zh: 环时，颜色会从红棕色变成紫色。

segments.text: Now let's look at our starting material, salicylic acid, and our product, acetylsalicylic
segments.zh: 现在我们来看看起始原料水杨酸，以及我们的产物乙酰水杨

segments.text: acid.
segments.zh: 酸。

segments.text: Which one has a phenol ring?
segments.zh: 哪一个有酚环呢？

segments.text: As you can see, salicylic acid has a phenol ring, and aspirin doesn't.
segments.zh: 如你所见，水杨酸有酚环，而阿司匹林没有。

segments.text: So if we add both the starting material and our product to tubes, and introduce iron 3
segments.zh: 所以如果我们把起始原料和产物分别加入试管中，再加入三氯

segments.text: chloride, the salicylic acid should turn purple, and aspirin should remain brown.
segments.zh: 化铁，水杨酸应该会变成紫色，而阿司匹林应该保持棕色。

segments.text: So if we have made and purified our aspirin, it shouldn't change color.
segments.zh: 所以如果我们制得并纯化了阿司匹林，它就不应该变色。

segments.text: If it does, either we didn't make any aspirin, or we've made it but didn't correctly
segments.zh: 如果变色了，要么是我们根本没有制得阿司匹林，要么是制得了但没有正确地

segments.text: separate it from the starting material.
segments.zh: 把它与起始原料分离开。

segments.text: So let's test our products.
segments.zh: 那么我们来检测一下产物。

segments.text: Here we have a tube of our starting material, a tube of our crude product after the first
segments.zh: 这里有一管起始原料、一管第一次结晶后的粗品，

segments.text: crystallization, and a tube of our final product.
segments.zh: 还有一管最终产物。

segments.text: We've also added a tube of pure water as our control to make sure that our test works
segments.zh: 我们还加了一管纯水作为对照，确保我们的检测能正常

segments.text: correctly.
segments.zh: 起作用。

segments.text: Now, after adding FeCl3 to each of our samples, let's look at the results.
segments.zh: 现在，往每个样品中加入 FeCl3 后，我们来看看结果。

segments.text: The starting material turned purple as expected.
segments.zh: 起始原料如预期那样变成了紫色。

segments.text: Then the crude product may turn purple, which would mean that there is still some starting
segments.zh: 然后粗品可能会变紫，这意味着里面仍然有一些起始

segments.text: material in there, but it may not if the product was cleaned enough that no significant
segments.zh: 原料，但如果产物已经足够干净，即使在粗品中也没有明显的

segments.text: impurities reside even within the crude product.
segments.zh: 杂质残留，它也可能不变紫。

segments.text: The pure product, as you can see, is brown, which is good news.
segments.zh: 如你所见，纯产物是棕色的，这是个好消息。

segments.text: That means that we have successfully made aspirin, and adequately purified it from the
segments.zh: 这意味着我们成功制得了阿司匹林，并充分地把它与

segments.text: starting material.
segments.zh: 起始原料分离纯化了。

segments.text: The control here is also brown, meaning that our test works as expected.
segments.zh: 这里的对照也是棕色的，说明我们的检测按预期起作用。

segments.text: And with that, you have now completed your first organic synthesis.
segments.zh: 这样，你就完成了你的第一次有机合成。

segments.text: This is about as simple as it gets for synthesis, so hopefully we can look at much more complicated
segments.zh: 这差不多是最简单的合成了，所以希望将来我们能看看复杂得多的

segments.text: synthetic techniques in the future.
segments.zh: 合成技术。

segments.zh: 感谢观看。
